parts.source:
&C4 = "a b"
msg("sp_emb_len=" + &C4.Length().ToString().Trim(), status)
msg("sp_emb_sub31=[" + Substr(&C4, 3, 1) + "]", status)
msg("sp_emb_sub22=[" + Substr(&C4, 2, 2) + "]", status)
&C4 = " ab"
msg("sp_lead_len=" + &C4.Length().ToString().Trim(), status)
msg("sp_lead_sub11=[" + Substr(&C4, 1, 1) + "]", status)
msg("sp_lead_sub22=[" + Substr(&C4, 2, 2) + "]", status)
&V20 = "ab "
msg("sp_trail_len=" + &V20.Length().ToString().Trim(), status)
msg("sp_trail_sub12=[" + Substr(&V20, 1, 2) + "]", status)
msg("sp_trail_sub22=[" + Substr(&V20, 2, 2) + "]", status)
msg("sp_trail_sub13=[" + Substr(&V20, 1, 3) + "]", status)
msg("sp_trail_sub31=[" + Substr(&V20, 3, 1) + "]", status)
msg("re_empty_find=[" + StrReplace("abc", "", "X") + "]", status)
&V20 = "áéíóúçñü"
msg("acc_len=" + &V20.Length().ToString().Trim(), status)
msg("acc_sub22=[" + Substr(&V20, 2, 2) + "]", status)
If Upper(&V20) = "ÁÉÍÓÚÇÑÜ"
 msg("acc_upper_eq=1", status)
Else
 msg("acc_upper_eq=0", status)
EndIf
If Lower("ÁÉÍÓÚÇÑÜ") = "áéíóúçñü"
 msg("acc_lower_eq=1", status)
Else
 msg("acc_lower_eq=0", status)
EndIf
msg("sharp_upper=[" + Upper("ß") + "]", status)
msg("sharp_lower=[" + Lower("ß") + "]", status)
msg("micro_upper=[" + Upper("µ") + "]", status)
msg("micro_lower=[" + Lower("µ") + "]", status)
msg("yuml_upper=[" + Upper("ÿ") + "]", status)
msg("yuml_lower=[" + Lower("Ÿ") + "]", status)
